entities.name: Ygra, Eater of All
entities.description: Calamity Beast of Bloomburrow, a giant elemental cougar with green-glowing stripes that turns life into pillars of salt.

entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: Plane of the animalfolk where Ygra stalks.

entities.name: Drought Cat
entities.description: A Calamity Beast named in the story; unclear whether it is another name for Ygra.

events.summary: Ygra stalks Bloomburrow, and life crumbles in its wake into pillars of salt.
events.quote: Wherever Ygra stalks, life crumbles immediately in its wake, turning into pillars of salt.
